Find more details on [Billing Guideline](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303191886361) 4. **Charges** : Amount billed or paid per the event on description * Positive values (+): indicate paid amount OR credit that can be used for your next payment * Negative values (-): charged to the user to be paid in future 5. **Credit balance** : Remaining credit balance as a result of each event. * Positive values (+): credit that can be used for your next payment * Negative values (-): amount owed to be paid in future * from below image, 1️⃣ ➕ 2️⃣ 🟰 3️⃣ ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778941893529) * ### Invoice * Click on the Invoice no. to print or download your invoice. Please note that the 'To' field will display the user id and email of the account that first initiated the payment (either Group Admin or Group Operator account will be listed). * On the invoice, you can find the list of members that has been charged for the listed subscription period. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778942101913) ### 2) User History #### 1\. Permission Approval * Find the list of permission requests & full list of users approved/pending/rejected from the Group **[All User Status]** Displays the full list of users invited to the Group (including approved, pending, removed) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778925421465) * * **Status** of the accounts are displayed as one of the four below: * Pending: pending request for approval to * Rejected: permission request rejected * Approved: request approved but the user is not registered on CLO-SET * Reapproved: request that had previously been rejected, then approved afterwards * Clicking on the active user's account email to view [Permission Management](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303209418649) info for the selected account **[Pending Users]** Displays the list of requests that are pending/rejected ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778880587033) * Once the new member is approved, the user will be deleted from the 'pending users' tab (but continue to display on the 'all user status' tab) * If the same user has been invited multiple times, approving the user on any 1 of the rows will automatically approve all requests #### 2\. User Type Change * View the full list of changes on Group members that affects your subscription amount. * **For more information on permission by space, visit 'Permission Management' tab within Admin Console.** ![userhis.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778925775897) #### 3\. Email Change * View the list of users within the Group with the email change history. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778942837401) ### 3) Usage History ![Screenshot 2024-11-01 at 6.20.30 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778897328921) * View the Group's feature usage history per measurement period. * User/Company/Workroom is displayed as max count by period * File Upload/Rendering/Embed View/API Call is displayed as total count by period * For more details on how CLO-SET measures each field, visit [Feature Usage Measurement Criteria](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303208104857) * Depending on your group's subscribed plan, there may be restrictions on field usage. Visit [CLO-SET Pricing](https://style.clo-set.com/service/pricing) page to learn more.

Enter the URL and click 'Update' button. 2\. Go to style page. You can see the sync button activated. ![style_sync](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/common/images/style_sync.png) 3\. Click sync button to open new tab with the URL you entered above. The new tab's URL contains Style ID, style version, external style ID as query string. ### [Set Render trigger] 1\. Click 'ADD TRIGGER' under Render section. 2\. Choose workflow status that fires the trigger. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778990334233) 3\. Go to Workroom or Style page and change Workflow of style, and refresh your browser to initiate Render. _*Render will be requested with the uploaded file's render properties set in CLO S/W._ ![RenderTrigger.gif](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778990683545) #### Potential Error Cases in Render Trigger Fail * In any case where render cannot be completed, Render Trigger can not also be completed * When file has not completed parsing * When file has failed parsing * When Render Setting is not yet set * Render Setting has to be set in order for Render Trigger to properly work #### Render Properties of CLO3D * Rendering properties can be saved as .zvrp. It can also be opened in CLO3D. ![](https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/IJpthF2Vv7VzUy4yc_9eFfkmHoKt9mGB83E0llEuZq18sTsl6Sws7QhHweS9l3Ux89xpIoGrgnKp_SN-NFh3uzgU8YiZblRU3hBJrffftCsaSb0zIdCJCMUwDEwbU4t-l9SfRMJr4xFkjpxwq4FWzyA) | ![](https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/L6yX0jT-bYhSn4XLtsB2jjmCHdIWMDMEF6EfqmzuD_3_9Q7DKTu_IWQdWfboncOiLVDUZ-6fTA6b5CcY5rILFTCGMpk2GjA9NTmPebmGuDc5xupldr__A_GA-DRYgXnk5lJ7uievTfgS_EXELt5Fxv0) ---|--- Render Properties of CLO3D When your Rendering Properties are established, you can then load the saved Rendering Properties without having to configure Rendering Properties every time. The loaded Rendering Properties will be saved as part of the .zprj file to be used in CLO-SET Trigger. ### [Set Webhook] #### 1\. Click 'Add trigger' under webhook section. 2\. Choose the trigger use case at which you want to fire the trigger. CLO-SET currently offers webhooks for 5 different use cases. \- Workflow: You can set a webhook to be fired at a specific Content Workflow. \- Invite / Share: You can set a webhook to be fired when a user has been invited/shared to a Space/Content. \- Content Upload: You can set a webhook to be fired when a Content is uploaded. \- Version Upload: You can set a webhook to be fired when a Version is uploaded. \- Colorway Status: You can set a webhook to be fired at a specific Colorway Status. 3\. Enter the URL that webhook will be requested. 4\. Enter the Name and Value if you want to check whether the request is valid. It will be added in HTTP header with webhook request. Webhook request body sample { "UpdateTime": "2020-07-21T06:25:09.759785Z", "UpdateUser": "hello@clo-set.com", "Topic": { "TopicId": "4ea0710a0e5f4e099d92f7a284d167f9", "Version": 1, "TopicType": 1 }, "TriggerType": 1, "TriggerOption": { "WorkflowSeq": 1679, "TriggerStatus": 1 } } Webhook body schema { "UpdateTime": { "$id": "#/properties/UpdateTime", "type": "string", "format": "date-time", "description": "The update time that trigger fired." }, "UpdateUser": { "$id": "#/properties/UpdateUser", "type": "string", "description": "Email address of user" }, "Topic": { "$id": "#/properties/Topic", "type": "object", "description": "The updated space/style information", "required": [ "TopicId", "Version", "TopicType" ], "properties": { "TopicId": { "$id": "#/properties/Topic/properties/TopicId", "type": "string", "description": "The id of updated style or space" }, "Version": { "$id": "#/properties/Topic/properties/Version", "type": "integer", "description": "Version of style. Will be '0' if topic type is not style.", "default": 0 }, "TopicType": { "$id": "#/properties/Topic/properties/TopicType", "type": "integer", "enum": [0, 1], "description": "Enum for what the topic type is. 0 is none, 1 is style.", "default": "None" } } }, "TriggerType": { "$id": "#/properties/TriggerType", "type": "integer", "enum": [0, 1], "description": "The trigger type that webhook triggered. 0 is none, 1 is workflow", "default": 0 }, "TriggerOption": { "$id": "#/properties/TriggerOption", "type": "object", "description": "The object information for trigger", "required": [ "WorkflowSeq", "TriggerStatus" ], "properties": { "WorkflowSeq": { "$id": "#/properties/TriggerOption/properties/WorkflowSeq", "type": "integer", "description": "Workflow seq that tiggered." }, "TriggerStatus": { "$id": "#/properties/TriggerOption/properties/TriggerStatus", "type": "integer", "enum": [0, 1], "description": "The changed trigger status for triggered object. 0 is none, 1 is changed", "default": 0 } } } }

title: Billing Guideline
content: # **Objective** Understand how CLO-SET Group Pricing works, as well as invoices and billing. 1. Payment per Group 2. Automatic Renewal 3. Who is included in the bill? 4. Adding/Removing Users 5. What is Credit? 6. Refund 7. Example: Your Billing History Explained # **Details** ### 1\. Payment per Group * CLO-SET Pricing plan operates on a [**Group**](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185480985) level. Subscribing to the Standard or Premium plan will be applied to all members within your Group. ### 2\. Automatic Renewal * Your subscription will be renewed every month. The monthly payment amount for your subscription may vary based on the number of users within your Group. * *All renewals are made on the same day your subscription started. As an exception, if you subscribed on the 31st, renewal will be done on the last day of every month (ex. on the months with 30 days only, your renewal will be on the 30th). ### 3\. Who is included in the bill? All users invited to or shared within the Group are included in the billing. This encompasses users with the following permissions: * Group Admin * Company Admin * Company Collaborator * Brand Admin * Brand Collaborator * Editor * Viewer **Note:** Users with only Group Operator permission are excluded from billing. Find out more on Permissions [HERE](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303153376537). To view or manage your Group's permissions, please visit [Permission Management](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303195393049) tab. ### 4\. Adding/Removing users during your subscription You may need to add additional team members to your Group after your subscription has begun. * **Adding User:** Charged on the next billing cycle. Amount calculated on a daily basis. Each additional user will be charged for the # of days they were in the Group (ex. for Premium Plan: $40➗ # of days in month). * The amount will be recorded as Credit on your Group. Please see below for an example. * **Removing User** : If you delete a user during your billing cycle, the amount of unused days will be refunded in a form of Credit on your account (ex. for Premium Plan: $40 ➗ # of days in month). This additional Credit will automatically be used on your next payment. However, these addition credit cannot be transferred into cash refunds. Please see below for an example. * _Added users are billed from the day they have been added. Removed users are refunded including the day they have been removed._ _* All 'days' are counted based on the UTC timezone._ _* **Note:** The Active/Inactive status does not affect billing. It simply indicates whether a user is currently using the features. Even users marked as Inactive on the **User Activity** page are still considered paid users._ ### 5\. What is Credit? * Any changes on number of users within your Group will be reflected on your Group's Credit. All Credit Balance will be processed in your next payment. See below for examples. ### 6\. Refund * CLO-SET does not provide refunds for the subscription once it is initiated. Addition credits will be forfeited without cash refunds when downgrading to the Free plan. * Your credit balance will be retained when switching between Premium and Standard plans. ### 7\. Example: Your Billing History Explained ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777989667737) 1. **Subscription Created** : Billed for 5 users on the Premium Plan. 2. **Payment Complete** : Payment complete, subscription started for 5 users. 3. **Added 1 User to the Group:** The additional user will be billed as a prorated credit based on the number of days remaining until the renewal date. The accrued credit will be charged on the Group's next renewal date. * In this example, total credit billed is $33.10 * (Price per user / Total days in billing period) * Remaining days until renewal * ($40 / 29) * 24 = $33.10 * This amount is billed on your next renewal date. 4. **Removed 1 User from the Group:** The unused days for this member will be refunded as a credit and automatically applied to your next payment. * In this example, total credit refunded is $33.33 * (Price per user / Total days in billing period) * Remaining days until renewal * ($40 / 30) * 25 = $33.33 * This amount will automatically apply to your next payment. However, canceling your subscription (switching to the Free Plan) will forfeit this credit.
content_description: This page provides a comprehensive overview of CLO-SET Group Pricing, detailing payment structures, user management, and billing processes to help you navigate your subscription effectively.

title: Search
content: # **Objective** Find your Contents with the search feature in CLO-SET. Find it fast. Find it easy. 1. [Search Tab](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/undefined#h_01H570RFSHKRKYPQ938B1SVKTB) 2. Keyword Search 3. Image Search 4. Filters 5. View / Sort Option 6. Workroom/Assortment Search # **Details** ### 1) Search Tab * Access the Search tab from the dashboard. Click the 'Search' icon on the far left. ![Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 9.10.54 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776088187161) | ![Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 9.17.22 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776097100057) ---|--- 1. 1. Keyword search 2. Image search 3. Reset search options 4. Filter search results 5. View/Sort option ### 2) Text Search ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776112246297) Search using the Content Name, Creator, or Content ID. Please note that only the Contents to which you have access to will be displayed as the search result. ### 3) Image Search ![Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 9.56.08 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776114269721) | ![Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 9.56.38 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776128898969) ---|--- To start searching with image files, click on 'search by image' icon next to the magnifier icon. Upload an image file, and click 'Apply'. CLO-SET AI will detect the shape, color, and pattern and find similar Contents. * Start searching with image files such as: * Rendered output of your Content * Physical image of the design * Pattern images used for the Content ![CLO-SET_Default_Final_Butter.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776114562073) | ► | ![Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 10.05.37 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776145656985) ---|---|--- ### 4) Filters ![Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 10.16.15 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776098255769) Use Search filters to expand or narrow down the search results. Learn what each of the filters indicate: * [Content Type](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801): Each Content is classified as a single Content Type. You may select the Content Type at the time of upload, or CLO-SET will auto-assign one based on your file format. * [Space](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303240419865): Select a Company, Brand, or Workroom Space to conduct the search. Click on the ► icon view lower-level Spaces. Once the selection is made, click 'Next'. * User must have 'Viewer' or above permission to select the respective Space. * [Workflow](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303233641241) / [Category](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303202913049): Can only be applied once the Space selection is made. ### 5) View/Sort Option ![Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 10.27.10 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776115130649) --- Modify viewing and sorting options: * View By: * Contents: Search results will show each Content only * Colorway: Search results will show each Colorway of the Content * Sort By: * Last Modified * Name: Sorting based on the file name. * [Workflow](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303233641241): Sorting based on the Workflow steps identified from your Company Settings * Relevance : Sorts results based on how closely they match the search keyword or image ### 6) Workroom/Assortment Search Users can search for a specific Workroom or Assortment by its name. Select the 'Workroom' or 'Assortment' option from the 'Search For' drop down next to the search bar. #### **1\. In Company, Brand, Line, Season** * From the 'Search For' drop-down menu, select 'Workroom' or 'Assortment' ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776146241433) * Type in the keyword to search for Workroom/Assortment. Search results display Workroom/Assortment with names that includes your input (Do not support placeholders) * When you search for a Workroom/Assortment within a specific Space (Company, Brand, or Line), ALL associated Workrooms/Assortments within that Space will be displayed * Hover over the Workroom to view the location path ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776098799129) #### **2\. In Season** * From the 'Search For' drop-down menu, select 'Workroom' or 'Assortment' ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776146620441) * Type in the keyword to search for Workroom/Assortment. Search results display Workroom/Assortment with names that includes your input (Do not support placeholders) * When you search for a Workroom/Assortment within the selected Season * Please note that the search results will **only** display either Workrooms or Assortments per your selection. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776157509913) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776116190233) ---|--- #### **3\. In Workroom** * From the 'Search For' drop-down menu, select 'Workroom' * Contents of Current Room: search the Contents within the current level Workroom only * Contents Including Child Rooms: search the contents from the current Workroom and all its child Workrooms. * Workrooms: search the Child Workrooms within the current Workroom * Type in the keyword to search for Child Workrooms. Search results display all Child Workrooms with names that includes your input (Do not support placeholders) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776116413465)
content_description: Discover and quickly locate your contents using CLO-SET's advanced search features for a seamless and efficient experience.

title: Custom View
content:
## **Objective** Understand how to use the custom view feature on CLO-SET. 1. What is Custom View? 2. Selecting Custom view option on CLO-SET Space / Dashboard 3. Selecting Custom view option on CLO-SET Content page 4. Selecting Custom view option on CLO Software ## **Details** #### **1) What is Custom View?** Custom View is a function in CLO3D that allows you to save a certain Viewpoint. Link to [Custom View](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115004420828-Custom-View) CLO3D. In CLO-SET, now we support thumbnail image and turntable images based on the Custom View. > 💡 **Note:** Custom View is available only for .**zprj files** as the Custom View data is only saved
> > for **.zprj file** > 💡 **Note:** Custom View is applied to anywhere utilizing thumbnail features, including **Linesheet** ,
> > **Visual Board** , **Web Tech Pack** and any other thumbnail images in CLO-SET. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47460161161369) #### **2) Selecting Custom View option on CLO-SET Space / Dashboard** In the Space and Dashboard areas of CLO-SET, you can select the "Custom View as Thumbnail" option when uploading a file. ![Body.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47482755327129) #### **3)****Selecting Custom View option on CLO-SET Content page** 1. 'Custom View' option is also available on the Content page of CLO-SET. By selecting Version Update on the Content page and choosing a single file, you can select the "Custom View as Thumbnail" function option.![Body.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47487698939673) 2. By selecting 'Create New Version' on the Colorway tab, you can select the "Custom View as Thumbnail" function option.![Body1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47487698940825) #### **4)****Selecting Custom View option on CLO Software** 1. When directly uploading from CLO software to CLO-SET, you can also use the Custom View function. By clicking the CLO-SET tab at the top, you can select either "Upload to CLO-SET" or "Render via CLO-SET." At this point, on the CLO-SET screen that appears, you can activate the function by clicking "Use Custom View as Thumbnail" toggle. * If the file does not have a custom view, this toggle will not be activated. ![Body2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47489108621977) 2. In the CLO software, you can access User Settings to configure options related to version updates. Here, you can enable the "Custom View as Thumbnail" function, which allows you to apply the custom view feature when working on a file imported from the CLO-SET library and performing an immediate version update. This operates independently of the Custom View Thumbnail function on the Direct Upload (Share via CLO-SET) described earlier. ![Body3.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47489108625945)
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to provide a comprehensive guide on utilizing the Custom View feature in CLO-SET, including its definition, selection process across various platforms, and integration with CLO software.

title: Plan Restrictions (Measurement Standard)
content: # **Objective** Understand plan limits and how the usage fields are calculated in CLO-SET. Your Group may have limited availability on selective features. Check[ CLO-SET Pricing Page](https://style.clo-set.com/service/pricing) for more details. 1. User 2. Company & Workroom 3. File Upload 4. Rendering 5. Embed View 6. CLO-SET API 7. Usage History 8. Plan Limit Error & Upgrade # **Details** Based on your Group's usage, you may need to upgrade your plan or pay additional charges. Visit **[CLO-SET Pricing page](https://style.clo-set.com/service/pricing)** to find the full list of plan types and feature availability. ![Screenshot 2025-05-28 at 5.31.58 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47456838666137) ### ### 1) User * Free Plan: invite/share with up to 3 users * Standard/Premium Plan: invite/share unlimited number of users. Charges apply per the number of users in the Group. * Users with Admin, Collaborator, Editor, or Viewer permission to any Space within the Group will be counted towards billing. Group Operators are not included. * Review the full list of users in the Group on [Console - Settings - Permission Management](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303209418649). * If CLO employees are invited to your Group for support, they are excluded from the user count. ### 2) Company & Workroom * Free Plan: create up to 1 Company and 1 Workroom * Standard Plan: create up to 1 Company and 10 Workrooms * Premium Plan: unlimited Space creation * All Companies and [Workrooms](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303190956697) within the Group are counted, even if there is no Content uploaded within the Space. * On CLO-SET dashboard, click 'Workspace' button from the left pane. Click 'All Companies' or 'All Workrooms' to view the full list, and make changes if needed. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778415314329) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778431143577) ### 3) File Upload * Free Plan: up to 10 files uploads per month. Renewed on the 1st of each month. * Standard/Premium Plan: unlimited file uploads and storage. * All file uploads, including version uploads and deleted files, are counted. * 'Sample.zprj' file created as a default is excluded from the count. * Visit [Console - Billing - Usage History](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303239183257) to review the file upload usage for each measurement period. ### 4) [Rendering](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303207203225) * Rendering usage is based on the Render output file size. For Rendering details, visit 'Workspace - Rendering' or '[Console - Billing - Usage History](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303239183257)' * Free Plan * up to 50MB per month. Limit resets on the 1st of each month. You must upgrade your plan to use more Rendering. * Premium & Standard Plan * up to 3 GB (Premium) or 1 GB (Standard) per user in the Group each month. Limit resets on the subscription renewal date. * Additional charges apply for usage exceeding the limit. **$10 per 1 GB** will be billed on the group’s next payment. * When you add a user to the group during your subscription, we’ll adjust the usage based on the remaining days and provide a proportional amount. ### 5) [Embed Viewer](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303195817497) * The Embed Viewer count is based on the number of times end users open the Embed Viewer created from the content within your group. This includes all direct visits via the URL/QR code and access through the 3D Viewer URL embedded in your [Visual Board](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303200610841). * Visit '[Console - Billing - Usage History](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303239183257)' to view the current status. * Add-on purchase option is not available for Embed Viewer usage. Please**upgrade or add users** to the Group to allow more view counts. * Free Plan * up to 30 views per month. Limit resets on the 1st of each month. You must upgrade for additional usage. * Standard Plan * up to 100 views per user in the Group each month. Limit resets on the subscription renewal date. You must upgrade for additional usage. * Premium Plan * up to 300 views per user in the Group each month. ### 6) [CLO-SET API ](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303242212505) * CLO-SET API is available under the Premium plan or Enterprise plan only. * All API calls made for your Group will be counted, except the oAuth option. * Premium Plan * up to 300 API Calls per user in the Group each month. title: Render Preset
content: Render Preset option allows you to provide a uniform Render Setting as a guideline throughout the Company. #### Permission (Add/Change/Delete): ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778769749529) Company Admin #### Permission (Use): ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778769749529) Admin, ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778790058265)Collaborator, ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778755814297)Editor *See below for permission details # **Objective** * [Save as ZVRP from CLO3D](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303245952537) * [Add/Change/Delete Render Preset](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303245952537) * [Using Render Preset](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303245952537) * [Render Preset - Properties](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303245952537) # **Details** ### 1) Save as ZVRP from CLO3D * To start using the new Render Preset feature in CLO-SET, you will need a ZVRP file. ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778770413977) | ► | ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778770671897) ---|---|--- * On CLO3D software, change Render settings you'd like to save using Property Editor (Image/Video, Light, and Render) * Once you are done, click **Save As > Render Properties** to save as **ZVRP** file. * The saved ZVRP includes Image/Video, Camera, Light, and Render properties. Scroll down to #4 for the detailed list of properties to be reflected on CLO-SET Render. * A few requirements for CLO-SET: * Image count for Turntable must be less than 64 * Image size must be less than 5,000px * Animation type can not be rendered *Please note: If you select the 'Current View' option from CLO3D, CLO-SET Render will be based on the last view each user sees on their CLO-SET 3D Viewer. ### ### 2)Add/Change/Delete Render Preset * **Company Admin ONLY **\- Managing the Render Preset for each Company can only be done by the Company Admin. If you are a Collaborator or below, please contact your Admin for support. * Click on your **Company > 'Settings' > 'Rendering'** to Add/Edit/Delete Render Preset. * Click on 'Upload File' to add a Render Preset. You may add up to 32 files. ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778770876313) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778775123481) ---|--- * Click on 'Change File' to upload a new ZVRP file. This will NOT affect the previous Render output. The new setting will be used for future Render works. * Click 'Download' to save the ZVRP file. * Click on the 𝒊 icon to view the property details. * Click on X to delete the Render Preset. ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778771416729) ### 3) Using Render Preset * Editors or above can utilize the Render Preset for each Content. * On your Content Page, click on Render to select the Render Settings. * On the drop-down menu, you will see the **Company Preset** (with ![company.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778798655129) icon) * Users may save a Preset for themselves. In this case, the individual user's Preset will be shown at the bottom of the drop-down menu. ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778791857433) | ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778799099289) ---|--- * Once you select the Company's Render Preset option, you can not change the Render Settings. You may check the Property details by clicking on the 𝒊 icon. ### 4) Render Preset - Properties Please find the full list of Render Property to be reflected on CLO-SET Render. **Image/Video Property** | ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778772254233) | * Image Type (image/ turntable) * Colorway * View Point * Image Format * Image Size * Unit (px/in/mm/cm) * Resolution * Color * Texture * Crop | ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778799426073) ---|---|---|--- For Turntable Image * Image Count * Rotation Angle * Rotation Axis * Direction * Save Video * Save GIF * Total Duration * Frame Duration * Video Format | ![Screenshot 2023-12-15 at 10.35.06 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778799697817) **Light Property** | ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778792888601) | * Preset * Rectangle Light * Sphere Light * Directional Light * Spot Light * IES Light * Dome Light | ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778793061785) **Render Property** | ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778789581721) | * Noise Threshold * Seam Puckering Intensity * Light * Material * Linear Workflow * Color Mapping Type * Burn Value | ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778777338905)![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778777570841) * A few requirements for CLO-SET: * Image count for Turntable must be less than 64 * Image size must be less than 5,000px * Animation type can not be rendered *Please note: If you select the 'Current View' option from CLO3D, CLO-SET Render will be based on the last view each user sees on their CLO-SET 3D Viewer.

content: # **Objective** Understand how to complete payments on CLO-SET and troubleshooting process. 1. Payment Process 2. Change Card & Billing Address 3. Troubleshooting Payments # **Details** ### 1) Payment Process 1\. Go to <https://style.clo-set.com/service/pricing>. Find plan details, and click 'Subscribe' to start. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778165209497) 2\. Start by entering your Payment information. Click on 'Enter Payment Details'. Insert card number, expiration date, security code, along with the cardholder name and address. Then, click 'Confirm'. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778187110041) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778187381401) ---|--- 3\. Once the payment info is registered, confirm billed amount, agree to the Terms, and click 'Order' to complete the payment * Subscription amount is based on the Plan Type, and the # of users in your [Group](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185480985). * If you have any carryover balance, it will be reflected on the bill as shown below (#2). ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778182229785) 4\. Once the payment is complete, you will see the below page. Start enjoying your subscription. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778172939161) ### 2) Change Card & Billing Address * To change the credit card information or billing address, visit [Console - Summary](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303236765721) page. Click 'Change' next to your payment information. * Click 'Change Card' to update card information or billing address. *Console page is accessible for Group Admin and Group Operator only. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778173122457) ### 3) Troubleshooting Payments Payment attempts may fail for several reasons. See below for a list of errors and how to resolve them. 1. [Your Group exceeds the number of Companies or Workrooms available under the plan] * This error is displayed when the Group attempts to downgrade the plan. If your Group's usage exceeds the limits of the selected plan, downgrading cannot be completed. Please[ review the limitations](https://style.clo-set.com/service/pricing) for each plan and make the necessary adjustments. Then, try downgrading again. 2. [There are Addition Credits that your Group should settle before re-subscribing] * This error is due to having unpaid credit balance on your account. As such cases need further review, please contact our [support](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new). 3. [Failed to register card information due to card issue] * Please double check your credit card information or billing address. If the issue persists, [contact us](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new). 4. [Upon upgrading, any remaining free trial period will be forfeited, and the payment will be charged immediately] * This message is not an error, but a notification. If you are currently on a Trial period, initiating a paid subscription would forfeit the remaining Trial period.

title: Web Tech Pack (WTP)
content:
#### Permission: ![Admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778041944473) Admin ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778042096537) Collaborator ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778024981913) Editor ### # **Objective** ![web tech pack.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778046859161) | CLO-SET Web Tech Pack integrates your everyday tech pack with 3D Contents. Let us bring all the data from your 3D file into an auto-generated Tech Pack. Enjoy a tech pack that is always up-to-date. ---|--- 1. What is Web Tech Pack (WTP)? 2. Requirements & Permission 3. WTP Tabs & Data * [Overview](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303217248665) * [BOM](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303192584601) * Construction * [Measurement](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303219189785) * Cost Estimtaion 4. WTP Version Update 5. WTP Comment ### # **Details** ### 1) What is 'Web Tech Pack (WTP)'? * Web Tech Pack is an **auto-generated Tech Pack** based on your 3D file. Manage production details such as BOM / POM / Cost information, always up-to-date for the whole team. * Information is managed and updated per **Colorway-Grade** combination, for all files uploaded from November 5th, 2024. For other files uploaded prior to this date, please re-upload. ![Screenshot 2023-07-21 at 2.46.38 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778025485977) ### 2) Requirements & Permission * Content Type: for a WTP to be created, the [Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801) must be 'Style' * if the 1st version uploaded is a zpac/zprj file, then the Content Type will automatically update to 'Style' * if the Content Type is NOT 'Style', then Web Tech Pack will not be activated even if the last version uploaded is a zpac/zprj file. * if the Content Type is 'Styl'e but the uploaded version is NOT a zpac/zprj file (ex. blank content, jpeg, fab, etc), then Web Tech Pack will be activated but it will not be able to load any data. * Access the Tech Pack page by clicking the ![web tech pack.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778046859161) (Web Tech Pack) button from Content page * You must have [Admin / Collaborator / Editor](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303153376537) permission to view the Web Tech Pack ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778047346329) ### 3) WTP Tabs & Data * #### WTP Tabs **Overview** | View the summary of the Content and manage Schedule. ---|--- **BOM** | Auto-generated BOM per Colorway and Grading. **Construction** | Mark detailed annotation per Fabric, Pattern, Graphic, etc. **Measurement** | POM information including 2D & target measurement for production. **Cost Estimation** | Cost Estimation including Fabric, Trim, Labor, Transportation, etc. * #### WTP data synchronization with Content Page (Editable) Content Information displayed below will be reflected on [WTP - Overview](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303217248665) --- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778025859225) | * Content Name * Company / Brand / Season / Line / Workroom * Workflow * Creator/Created Date * Thumbnail * Tags * Category * Description * [Custom Information Fields](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303239598617) * ### 4) WTP Version Update
``` ![merge_modal.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778060102681) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778047796761)
``` * When you upload a [new version](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303241367961) of the Style Content, you have an option to update the WTP * If you upload a file format other than .zprj/.zpac as a new version to a[ Style Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801), * New WTP information will be reflected on BOM / Construction / Measurement / Cost Estimation. * Once you click 'UPDATE', the Style information in Web Tech Pack will be updated. * If you accidentally press the 'CANCEL' button, you must re-upload the same file. Cancelling cannot be undone. * What does an 'update' to in Web Tech Pack? * If new materials were added to the project file, the new materials will be added to the BOM * If the existing materials have been updated from the software, the updates will be reflected to the new version of the Web Tech Pack * If you have deleted any material on the previous versions of the Web Tech Pack, the new version will EXCLUDE the deleted materials, even if it is included on the new project file uploaded. * Version updates on the Trim files registered on the BOM is NOT reflected automatically * Editing the Web Tech Pack information manually can only be done on the latest WTP version * Once you update the Web Tech Pack version, deleting the new version file from the Content Page will NOT delete the corresponding WTP version. You will be able to review the data, but the WTP will be marked as 'deleted'. ### 5) Web Tech Pack Comment * [Commenting](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171263641) is also available on all tabs. * Comments are created/saved separate on each Tab (Overview, BOM, Construction, Measurement, and Cost Estimation). * Under each Comment, you can find the version information of the uploaded file. * Please follow the [hyperlink](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171263641) to find permissions details ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778060391065)
